draft_text: The reported 142 versus 119 requests per second provide tentative evidence that Nimbrake might possibly achieve higher throughput than Caskline on Driftbay-Serve.
revised_text: Nimbrake measured 142 requests per second and Caskline 119 requests per second on Driftbay-Serve, though the figures are not directly comparable because Nimbrake used batch size 32 and Caskline used batch size 16.
rationale: Numbers 142 and 119 match T1. However, the table note states the figures are not directly comparable (different batch sizes), so the claim that they "provide tentative evidence" of higher throughput overstates the evidence. No statistical test was reported.
